summary: Phase 4 partially complete. splitAt_combine proved sorry-free (subagent). neg_bracket_zero_is_vbracket (Lemma 5.1 base case) proved sorry-free. Phase 1 now fully COMPLETED. Inductive step of Lemma 5.1 blocked on design issue: peel-off-first-witness approach does not generalize to brackets with segment types. Two sorries remain, build passes.

sorry_inventory.assumption: The negation of a bracket formula with n+1 witnesses is a V-bracket on Prior structures
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: The Lemma 5.3 peel-off-first-witness approach fails for general brackets: finding first alpha_0-occurrence r0 via HasAttainedINF gives not-alpha_0 on (z0,r0) but NOT beta_0 on (z0,r0), so splitAt_combine cannot reconstruct. Need segment-type-based decomposition or F-chain reverse direction.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Research: (A) decompose by first segment type failure + Lemma 5.3, or (B) prove F-chain reverse direction on Prior structures, or (C) add endpoint conditions to bracket formula to match the paper's convention.
After Lemma 5.1: express partial bracket as bracket on (z0,z1) via F-chain, apply Lemma 5.1

blockers: Lemma 5.1 inductive step: need correct decomposition strategy for bracket negation with segment types (the paper's three-case approach assumes endpoint conditions our BracketFormula lacks)

key_design_decisions: BracketFormula.prepend uses dite for Fin proofs; prepend_holds and prepend_holds_inv proved sorry-free
orderedPointsExist_decompose factored as standalone helper for witness combination
VBracketFormula.prependAll constructs negation VBracket syntactically from IH disjuncts
BracketFormula.fChainFrom uses well-founded recursion on (n - i.val) for F-chain construction
neg_partialBracketExist_sufficient proved via Lemma 5.3 composition (one-directional but sorry-free)
splitAt_combine proved sorry-free via 4-case split with dif_pos/dif_neg and congr+Fin.ext_iff+omega

CRITICAL: Peel-off-first-witness approach does NOT generalize from Lemma 5.3 to Lemma 5.1. Our BracketFormula has ALL witnesses interior with NO endpoint conditions, while the paper places alpha_0 at endpoint z_0. Segment type coupling prevents reconstruction via splitAt_combine.
